items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: I said, I worked with Tiny Bradshaw there, because I was commuting back and forth from New York to Chicago to do the shows.

ctx.x: What other bands did you work with? Cause I know you worked in a lot of clubs, right? (Inaudible.)

Yeah, well, I had worked with Tiny Bradshaw, of course. I didn't myself work in the show, I was doing the choreography and producing it, in Chicago, and more or less, I did the shows around here in the clubs which they used more or less local talent. And that's --
